With every pounding beat, another memory was painted over.

They peeled away one after another. In other words, I forgot.

All of it fades away.
In other words, oblivion.

Monday morning. For no particular reason, my steps felt light.
After several days of anything but a normal life, perhaps my body had finally learned to savor the blessing of an ordinary day.

“……”
“Hm? What’s with the serious face, Tohno? Forget something at home?”
